part.text:
All tests pass. The fix clones the material array (not the materials themselves) in `copy()` of:

- src/objects/Mesh.js:68
- src/objects/Line.js:37
- src/objects/Points.js:35

Each now uses `Array.isArray( source.material ) ? source.material.slice() : source.material`, so clones get their own material array while sharing the material references. Sprite was left unchanged since its material is never an array. The Mesh/Line/Points unit tests (including the new `copy/material` cases asserting array cloning) pass with 0 failures.
